item.title: Version 4.11.1
item.description:
Notch So Good 4.11.1

  • Helpers no longer cry "Finished": when Claude Code hands a job to Codex or Gemini in the background, you hear about it once, when Claude itself is done
  • A finished card reads as plain words: links, bold and file paths in an agent's last message no longer show their markdown

Install this one by hand: run brew upgrade notch-so-good, or download it from the release page. From 4.11.1 on, updates install themselves.
